title: Oven Toasted Norwegian Bread Casserole
description: A floral and velvety Norwegian dish featuring stale bread and dashi extract, perfect for an adventurous ovo-vegetarian meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onion until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, dashi extract, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked mushroom mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Tear the stale bread into small pieces and add to the bowl, stirring until the bread is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the eggs are set and the bread is toasted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
